trajectory_scores.evidence: Source-to-output bindings stayed explicit for each villa, and every final check used the latest exported file named in the contract.
The run advanced steadily, but included an avoidable batch/preset retry and one crop-quality parameter retry before the accepted exports.
The agent detected the rejected crop quality and center-crop fallback, corrected the parameter, then visually checked the resulting compositions.
All three PNGs were decoded and measured at 1920 x 1080; the brochure was decoded, counted at 6 pages, checked at A4 trim, and all rendered pages were visually inspected.
Tool failures, retries, the center-crop fallback, and the still-pending independent creative review are disclosed in the trajectory and release state.
